initiatives.name: Louisville Showing Up for Racial Justice (LSURJ)
initiatives.description: Louisville chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice. Organizes white people in Louisville around campaigns like Care Not Cages and a Community Defense Network, plus canvassing and trainings.

initiatives.name: Change Today, Change Tomorrow
initiatives.description: Black woman-led nonprofit founded in 2019 in Louisville's West End. Runs food distribution (Feed the West, Zero Hunger Mobile Market), youth programs and public health work.

initiatives.name: Collective Liberation Network
initiatives.description: Louisville group that coordinated mutual aid for queer and trans BIPOC leaders during the 2020 uprising, including meals for protesters and amplifying organizing opportunities.

initiatives.name: Louisville Workers Brigade
initiatives.description: Louisville workers' publication and group that writes about local union drives and strikes and hosts panels with workers organizing their workplaces.
